name: Cichol
text: Cichol, sometimes spelled Cical, led the Fomorians in the Lebor Gabála Érenn, the early Irish pseudo-history of successive invasions. Some texts attach the cognomen Gricenchos to his name, with Grichnos and Gricenchoss as further variants. He meets a rare setback when the arriving Partholonians defeat him. A note on the name links it to Irish cicul, a term for an astronomical cycle.

okr.objective: Cichol leads the Fomorians and falls to the Partholonians in early Irish pseudo-history.
key_results: He leads the Fomorians in the Lebor Gabála Érenn.
The Partholonians defeat him in a rare check to Fomorian power.
His name carries the cognomen Gricenchos, with Cical as a spelling variant.
okr.evidence: MacKillop, Dictionary of Celtic Mythology, s.v. Cichol
